_purpose: Adjudication allowlist for the CardDemo Python dependency supply-chain audit gate (QA finding F-SUPPLY-NO-AUDIT-GATE). Consumed by scripts/test_env.sh:carddemo_audit_python_deps, which runs pip-audit against tests/requirements-test.txt and FAILS the gate (RC=8) on any advisory whose identifier is NOT listed under 'adjudications' below.
_policy: FAIL-CLOSED. The default state is an EMPTY adjudications list, meaning every advisory pip-audit reports fails the gate until a human explicitly and durably accepts it here. A numeric CVSS threshold was deliberately NOT used because pip-audit's OSV/PyPI feed does not emit a uniform, reliable severity for every advisory; requiring a written, owned adjudication per ID makes each suppression an auditable decision instead of an opaque cutoff.
_id_format: Vulnerability identifiers are exactly as emitted by pip-audit (OSV/PYSEC identifiers such as 'PYSEC-2024-1234', and/or GHSA/CVE aliases such as 'GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx' / 'CVE-2024-12345'). Match is on the 'id' field; list every id that must be suppressed.

_example.reason: EXAMPLE ONLY (not active — this id is not real). Illustrates how to adjudicate a dev-only advisory: e.g. an advisory in the LocalStack emulator, which is a TEST-ONLY AWS stand-in that is never deployed to any production or internet-facing environment, so the advisory is not exploitable in this project's threat model.

_how_to_add: Copy the shape of '_example' into the 'adjudications' array with a REAL pip-audit id, the affected package/version, a concrete non-exploitability or accepted-risk justification, an owner, the adjudication date, and a review-by date. Never add an entry without a real justification.
